== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Spiritual Origin test is a semi-annual ritual conducted by the clans of [[Sacred Valley]]. During this event, children between the ages of six and eight are evaluated by clan elders to reveal the nature of their spirits. Participants typically wear formal attire, such as layered robes for boys or shadesilk wraps for girls, while their parents observe the proceedings with anticipation. Although the test is a celebrated tradition within the valley, it has been described as a deceptive practice that utilizes a bowl of liquid [[madra]]. Rather than revealing an individual's ultimate potential, the test merely identifies a person's starting point or their greatest strength. For example, being identified as a [[Forger]] indicates that an individual will face significant challenges when attempting to become an [[Enforcer]]. Outside of the [[Sacred Valley]], true [[sacred artists]] are expected to master the four basic disciplines and harvest a [[Remnant]].}}
